Title: Legacy LOB data types in code (text/ntext/image)
Recommendation: Replace text/ntext/image with varchar(max)/nvarchar(max)/varbinary(max); update casts, declares and parameters accordingly.
Description: Deprecated since SQL Server 2016; still works on 2022/2025 but blocks modern features (JSON, some string functions, in-memory, columnstore on those columns).

Title: Legacy LOB data types in inline DDL (CREATE TABLE #temp ...)
Recommendation: Use varchar(max)/nvarchar(max)/varbinary(max) in temporary and dynamic DDL.
Description: Legacy type declarations inside CREATE TABLE / ALTER TABLE statements.

Title: Deprecated security / ownership stored procedures
Recommendation: Replace with CREATE/ALTER/DROP LOGIN, USER and ROLE, ALTER AUTHORIZATION and EXECUTE AS. Legacy procedures do not reflect the post-2008 permissions model.
Description: Legacy security procedures: deprecated, behave incorrectly against the modern permissions hierarchy.

Title: Deprecated metadata / database-management stored procedures
Recommendation: Replace with the documented modern equivalent (ALTER INDEX, sys.dm_tran_locks, sys.dm_sql_referencing_entities, CREATE/DROP TYPE, ALTER DATABASE ... MODIFY NAME, etc.).
Description: Deprecated system procedures still callable but scheduled for removal.

Title: Deprecated metadata / security built-in functions
Recommendation: Use DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(), FILE_IDEX()/sys.index_columns, sys.fn_my_permissions, sys.dm_exec_sql_text and the corresponding DMVs.
Description: Deprecated built-in functions.

Title: Legacy system compatibility views (sysobjects, syscomments, ...)
Recommendation: Migrate to sys catalog views (sys.tables, sys.columns, sys.sql_modules, ...). Compatibility views do not expose metadata for post-2005 features.
Description: SQL Server 2000-era compatibility views: deprecated, incomplete metadata.

Title: SQL Trace / legacy dependency catalog objects
Recommendation: Replace SQL Trace with Extended Events; replace sys.sql_dependencies with sys.sql_expression_dependencies.
Description: SQL Trace APIs and sys.sql_dependencies are deprecated in favour of Extended Events.

Title: Remote-server (pre-linked-server) constructs
Recommendation: Replace remote servers with linked servers.
Description: Remote server APIs deprecated in favour of linked servers.

Title: Deprecated DBCC commands
Recommendation: DBCC DBREINDEX -> ALTER INDEX ... REBUILD; DBCC INDEXDEFRAG -> ALTER INDEX ... REORGANIZE; DBCC SHOWCONTIG -> sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats; PINTABLE has no effect.
Description: Deprecated DBCC commands with documented modern replacements.

Title: SET ROWCOUNT used to limit DML
Recommendation: Use the TOP keyword on the individual INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE statement instead of SET ROWCOUNT.
Description: SET ROWCOUNT for INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE is deprecated (feature id 109).

Title: Deprecated SET options (ANSI_NULLS OFF, OFFSETS, FMTONLY ...)
Recommendation: ANSI_NULLS/ANSI_PADDING/CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL are permanently ON in a future version; SET OFFSETS will be unavailable; use sp_describe_first_result_set instead of SET FMTONLY.
Description: Deprecated SET options documented in the 2016/2017 deprecation list.

Title: Legacy :: function-call syntax
Recommendation: Replace "::fn_name()" with "SELECT ... FROM sys.fn_name()".
Description: The :: function-calling sequence is deprecated.

Title: GROUP BY ALL
Recommendation: Rewrite using explicit GROUP BY values, UNION/derived tables.
Description: GROUP BY ALL is deprecated with no direct replacement.

Title: Deprecated table-hint syntax (no WITH keyword / hint without parentheses)
Recommendation: Use the current syntax: FROM t WITH (HOLDLOCK, NOLOCK). Hints applied without WITH or without parentheses are deprecated.
Description: Table hints specified without the WITH keyword or without parentheses.

Title: NOLOCK/READUNCOMMITTED inside UPDATE ... FROM / DELETE ... FROM
Recommendation: Remove NOLOCK/READUNCOMMITTED from the FROM clause of UPDATE/DELETE statements (documented deprecation, feature id 1).
Description: NOLOCK or READUNCOMMITTED in the FROM clause of an UPDATE or DELETE statement.

Title: String-literal column alias ('alias' = expression)
Recommendation: Use expression AS [alias] syntax instead of a quoted string on the left of =.
Description: A quoted string used as a column alias for an expression ('x' = expr) is deprecated.

Title: ROWGUIDCOL / IDENTITYCOL referenced as a column name in DML
Recommendation: Use $rowguid / $identity pseudo-columns instead of naming ROWGUIDCOL/IDENTITYCOL columns directly in DML.
Description: ROWGUIDCOL/IDENTITYCOL used as column names in DML statements.

Title: DROP INDEX using table_name.index_name syntax
Recommendation: Use DROP INDEX index_name ON table_name.
Description: DROP INDEX with two-part table.index name is deprecated.

Title: Text-pointer operations (WRITETEXT/UPDATETEXT/READTEXT/TEXTPTR/TEXTVALID)
Recommendation: These only exist for text/ntext/image columns - convert the columns to (n)varchar(max)/varbinary(max) and use normal UPDATE/INSERT.
Description: Text-pointer APIs tied to deprecated text/ntext/image columns.

Title: FOR XML ... XMLDATA (inline XDR schema)
Recommendation: Use XSD generation (remove XMLDATA) for RAW/AUTO modes.
Description: The XMLDATA directive to FOR XML is deprecated.

Title: Numbered procedures (CREATE PROCEDURE name;2)
Recommendation: Numbered procedures are deprecated - do not use; split into separate procedures.
Description: Numbered procedures (ProcNums) are deprecated with no replacement.

Title: BACKUP/RESTORE to tape or with PASSWORD
Recommendation: Backup to DISK/URL instead of TO TAPE; RESTORE ... WITH PASSWORD / MEDIAPASSWORD is deprecated (BACKUP with password is discontinued).
Description: Backup/restore to tape and with password options are deprecated/discontinued.

Title: Weak hash algorithm in HASHBYTES (MD2/MD4/MD5/SHA/SHA1)
Recommendation: Use SHA2_256 or SHA2_512. Older algorithms raise a deprecation event and are cryptographically broken.
Description: MD2/MD4/MD5/SHA/SHA1 in HASHBYTES are deprecated.

Title: Deprecated encryption algorithms (RC4/RC4_128/DESX)
Recommendation: Use AES (ENCRYPTBYKEY with a certificate/Asymmetric key or AES-based symmetric keys).
Description: RC4/RC4_128/DESX encryption algorithms are deprecated (decryption still supported).

Title: Native XML Web Service endpoints (FOR SOAP)
Recommendation: Replace SOAP endpoints with WCF/ASP.NET services.
Description: CREATE ENDPOINT ... FOR SOAP / sys.soap_endpoints are deprecated.

Title: GRANT/DENY/REVOKE ALL
Recommendation: Grant/deny/revoke specific permissions instead of ALL - new permissions are silently included/excluded by ALL.
Description: GRANT/DENY/REVOKE ALL is deprecated.

Title: Deprecated sp_configure options
Pattern: (?i)\bsp_configure\b[^;]{0,150}?\x27(?:allow updates|locks|open objects|set working set size|priority boost|remote proc trans|c2 audit mode|default trace enabled)\x27
Recommendation: Remove no-effect legacy options; replace c2 audit mode / default trace with Extended Events + common criteria option.
Description: Legacy sp_configure options that are deprecated or have no effect.

Title: Trigger returns a result set
Recommendation: Remove result-set-returning SELECT statements from triggers - returning result sets from triggers is deprecated with no replacement (use tables/temp tables + OUTPUT).
Description: Heuristic detector: SELECT statements in triggers that are not assignments, EXISTS/expressions or INSERT...SELECT.

Title: Dynamic SQL detected (not statically verifiable)
Recommendation: Review dynamically generated text manually (or enable the deprecated-features Extended Events session to capture runtime usage).
Description: Dynamic SQL hides code from static analysis - flagged explicitly instead of silently passing.

Title: Encrypted module definition unavailable
Recommendation: Obtain the definition from source control or decrypt with the original owner; encrypted modules cannot be assessed.
Description: WITH ENCRYPTION modules cannot be parsed - reported as not assessable.

Title: xp_cmdshell usage
Recommendation: Remove xp_cmdshell where possible; replace with External Tools / PowerShell / CLR / xp_cmdshell-free patterns; if kept, restrict via proxy accounts.
Description: xp_cmdshell is a privilege-escalation surface; keep disabled on the target.

Title: OLE Automation (sp_OA*) usage
Recommendation: Replace OLE Automation with CLR, External Tools, or modern scripting (PowerShell); enable only if still required.
Description: OLE Automation procedures are a legacy automation surface.

Title: Ad-hoc distributed query (OPENROWSET/OPENDATASOURCE)
Recommendation: Prefer linked servers or external tools; ensure Ad Hoc Distributed Queries stays disabled unless required.
Description: Ad-hoc distributed queries often rely on deprecated/legacy providers.

Title: Cursor usage (modernization candidate)
Recommendation: Consider set-based alternatives - cursors usually regress badly under newer cardinality-estimation models.
Description: Set-based rewrite opportunity.

Title: NOLOCK / READUNCOMMITTED hints (modernization)
Recommendation: Consider READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT (RCSI) and remove NOLOCK: dirty/non-repeatable reads disappear and hint-driven plans become stable across compatibility levels.
Description: NOLOCK is a frequent source of plan instability and dirty reads.

Title: SELECT * usage (schema-change fragility)
Recommendation: Name columns explicitly - SELECT * breaks result sets when the target schema evolves and defeats columnstore/covering indexes.
Description: SELECT * makes schema changes risky during/after migration.

Title: Database compatibility level below target
Recommendation: Raise the compatibility level in stages on the target, with Query Store baseline before/after each step; CE model and IQP features change with compatibility level.
Description: Engine version and compatibility level are separate: staying on 130 on a 2022 engine changes nothing until the level moves - and when it moves, plans can change.

Title: Very old compatibility level (<=120) is deprecated
Recommendation: Plan an upgrade path to a supported compatibility level; levels 100 (and 110/120) are documented as deprecated.
Description: Compatibility levels 100/110/120 are deprecated per Microsoft documentation.

Title: Deprecated database options (ANSI_NULLS OFF / CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL OFF / ANSI_PADDING OFF)
Recommendation: Set the option back to ON and validate dependent code - these are permanently ON in a future version of SQL Server.
Description: Database-level ANSI options set OFF are deprecated (they will always be ON).

Title: Query Store is OFF (no upgrade baseline)
Recommendation: Enable Query Store (READ_WRITE) on the source now to capture a plan/runtime baseline; compare it after the compatibility-level change.
Description: Microsoft-recommended way to detect plan regressions caused by a version/compat upgrade.

Title: TRUSTWORTHY database enabled
Recommendation: Prefer signed assemblies + explicit permissions over TRUSTWORTHY; restrict TRUSTWORTHY to databases that require it.
Description: TRUSTWORTHY widens the privilege-escalation surface and is the legacy workaround for CLR trust.

Title: Stretch Database enabled (discontinued)
Recommendation: Stretch Database was discontinued in all supported SQL Server versions (July 2024). Disable remote data archive and choose an alternative archive design before upgrading.
Description: Stretch Database is discontinued - the feature will not be available on the target.

Title: Full-Text index present (SQL Server 2025 word-breaker/filter removal)
Recommendation: After upgrading to SQL Server 2025, rebuild/recreate Full-Text indexes so they use version 2 components - queries and populations on legacy indexes fail immediately after upgrade.
Description: SQL 2025 removes legacy word-breaker/filter binaries; existing (version 1) Full-Text indexes fail until rebuilt.

Title: PolyBase external data source using Hadoop / wasb / abfs (unsupported on 2022+)
Recommendation: Recreate the external data source with the new connectors (wasb[s] -> abs, abfs[s] -> adls). TYPE = HADOOP external sources are unsupported in SQL Server 2022 and later.
Description: Hadoop (HDFS) external data sources are no longer supported in SQL Server 2022+; external tables using them must be recreated.

Title: Database Mirroring configured (deprecated)
Recommendation: Move to Always On availability groups (or log shipping when the edition does not support AGs).
Description: Database mirroring is deprecated in favour of Always On availability groups.

Title: Table columns with deprecated LOB types (text/ntext/image)
Recommendation: Migrate columns to varchar(max)/nvarchar(max)/varbinary(max): requires ALTER COLUMN plus data movement (SSMA/DMA can script it) and application driver review.
Description: text/ntext/image are deprecated; conversion is a schema+data change, not a flag change.

Title: Columns declared with the timestamp (rowversion) synonym
Recommendation: Rename the type to rowversion (identical semantics) for clarity and future compatibility.
Description: The timestamp syntax for rowversion is deprecated.

Title: Legacy CREATE DEFAULT / CREATE RULE objects
Recommendation: Replace old-style defaults/rules with DEFAULT constraints and CHECK constraints, then drop the legacy objects.
Description: CREATE/DROP DEFAULT, sp_bindefault, CREATE/DROP RULE, sp_bindrule are deprecated.

Title: Synonym targets a cross-database or linked-server object
Recommendation: Confirm the remote database/server also exists on the target side; four-part names are a common silent break during migration.
Description: Cross-part references move scope outside the database being migrated.

Title: CLR assembly may fail to load (CLR strict security, default since 2017)
Recommendation: Sign every assembly with a certificate/asymmetric key whose login has UNSAFE ASSEMBLY in master, or register it with sys.sp_add_trusted_assembly. Unsigned assemblies fail to load on the target.
Description: clr strict security = 1 (default on 2017+) makes the engine treat all assemblies as UNSAFE; unsigned assemblies fail to load.

Title: CLR assembly with EXTERNAL_ACCESS / UNSAFE permission
Recommendation: Re-validate permissions: with clr strict security enabled PERMISSION_SET is ignored at run time - all assemblies need trust, and UNSAFE code needs explicit approval.
Description: Permission set metadata is preserved but ignored at runtime when strict security is on.

Title: Linked server uses the deprecated SQLOLEDB provider
Recommendation: Migrate the linked server to Microsoft OLE DB Driver (MSOLEDBSQL) or ODBC (MSODBCSQL); SQLOLEDB is deprecated and not recommended.
Description: Specifying SQLOLEDB for linked servers is deprecated.

Title: Linked server uses the removed SQL Server Native Client (SQLNCLI) provider
Recommendation: SQLNCLI/SQLNCLI11 (SNAC) is no longer shipped with SQL Server 2022+ or SSMS 19+ - move the provider to MSOLEDBSQL/MSODBCSQL before or during the upgrade.
Description: SNAC was removed from SQL Server 2022 and later.

Title: Linked server may break on SQL Server 2025 (OLE DB 19 encryption defaults)
Recommendation: Test every linked server after upgrade: MSOLEDBSQL19 secure defaults (TrustServerCertificate=False) break existing configurations unless a valid certificate is configured or the Encrypt parameter is set explicitly.
Description: SQL Server 2025 introduces encryption changes that break existing linked-server configurations.

Title: Replication topology (remote distributor) affected by SQL Server 2025 encryption changes
Recommendation: Before upgrading: configure a trusted certificate on publisher/distributor (recommended) or set trust_distributor_certificate=yes. Without it, publication changes and Replication Monitor fail after upgrade.
Description: Remote-distributor replication fails after upgrade without a trusted certificate.

Title: Log shipping with a remote monitor affected by SQL Server 2025 encryption changes
Recommendation: Ensure the monitor uses trusted certificates before upgrading any node to SQL Server 2025.
Description: Remote log shipping monitoring can break after upgrade to SQL Server 2025.

Title: Data Quality Services present - DISCONTINUED in SQL Server 2025
Recommendation: Remove DQS before upgrading (upgrade fails if DQS is installed) and migrate DQS knowledge to an external service; DQS remains supported only on 2022 and earlier.
Description: DQS is removed in SQL Server 2025; the documented upgrade path fails while DQS is installed.

Title: Data Quality Services deprecated (removed in 2025)
Recommendation: DQS has been deprecated since SQL Server 2016 and is removed in 2025 - plan the replacement now while upgrading to 2022.
Description: DQS is on the deprecated list since 2016.

Title: Master Data Services present - DISCONTINUED in SQL Server 2025
Recommendation: MDS is removed in SQL Server 2025 - migrate MDS models to another MDM solution or Azure before targeting 2025.
Description: MDS is removed in SQL Server 2025.

Title: Master Data Services deprecated (removed in 2025)
Recommendation: MDS has been deprecated since SQL Server 2016 and is removed in 2025 - plan the replacement while upgrading to 2022.
Description: MDS is on the deprecated list since 2016.

Title: Machine Learning Services external scripts enabled (packages/runtimes changed)
Recommendation: SQL Server 2022 setup no longer installs R/Python runtimes or the microsoftml/olapR/sqlrutils/MicrosoftML packages - reinstall required custom runtimes/packages after upgrade and re-test sp_execute_external_script.
Description: ML Services packages are no longer included with SQL Server 2022 installation; Machine Learning Server itself is deprecated in 2022.

Title: Lightweight pooling (fiber mode) enabled - deprecated in SQL Server 2025
Recommendation: Disable lightweight pooling before moving to SQL Server 2025 - it is deprecated and planned for removal.
Description: Lightweight pooling / fiber mode is deprecated in SQL Server 2025.

Title: Startup/active trace flags detected
Recommendation: Verify each trace flag is still required and supported on the target version - flags silently lose meaning across releases.
Description: Trace flags are version-specific configuration that upgrades carry over blindly.

Title: Deprecated feature observed at RUNTIME on this instance
Recommendation: The deprecated-features counter shows real usage (often inside dynamic SQL that static analysis cannot see) - track down the caller and remediate it.
Description: Runtime evidence from sys.dm_os_performance_counters (Deprecated Features object).

Title: Non-T-SQL Agent job steps not analyzed (SSIS/CmdExec/PowerShell)
Recommendation: Review SSIS packages, CmdExec and PowerShell steps separately - they may embed connection strings, drivers (SNAC/SQLOLEDB) and legacy SQL.
Description: Only T-SQL job steps can be parsed by this tool.

Title: SQL Agent net send / pager notifications (deprecated)
Recommendation: Replace net send / pager notifications with e-mail notifications.
Description: net send and pager notifications are deprecated.

Title: Database name suggests DQS/MDS content
Recommendation: Confirm whether this database belongs to Data Quality Services or Master Data Services (both are removed in SQL Server 2025).
Description: Name-based heuristic - verify manually.

Title: Persisted edition-sensitive feature in use
Recommendation: Confirm the target edition supports every feature listed in sys.dm_db_persisted_sku_features before restore or migration. These features survive upgrade and can block a lower edition.
Description: SKU features such as compression, partitioning, CDC, columnstore, In-Memory OLTP and TDE.

Title: Change Data Capture is enabled
Recommendation: Plan the CDC capture and cleanup jobs across the upgrade. Capture jobs are SQL Agent jobs and must be rechecked on the target.
Description: CDC tables and the database CDC flag.

Title: Change Tracking is enabled
Recommendation: Confirm change-tracking retention and the application that consumes the version still work after the compatibility-level change.
Description: Tables registered with change tracking.

Title: In-Memory OLTP tables present
Recommendation: In-Memory OLTP has its own checkpoint filegroup and version limits. Validate natively compiled modules on the target; do not assume a disk-based upgrade covers them.
Description: Memory-optimized tables.

Title: FILESTREAM or FileTable is in use
Recommendation: FILESTREAM filegroups and FileTables need the same filesystem share and Windows feature on the target host. They are not moved by a database-only backup unless the share is recreated.
Description: Filestream filegroups and FileTables.

Title: Service Broker queues present
Recommendation: Broker routes, endpoints and dialog security must be recreated or altered on the target. A restored database does not keep remote routes valid.
Description: User Service Broker queues.

Title: Partition functions present
Recommendation: Partition schemes move with the database. Confirm filegroups exist on the target and that sliding-window jobs still match the new engine.
Description: Partition functions.

Title: XML schema collections present
Recommendation: XML schema collections move with the database. Re-test typed XML columns if the application depends on schema validation behavior.
Description: User XML schema collections.

Title: Database master key present
Recommendation: After restore, open the database master key with its password or regenerate it from the new service master key. Encrypted data stays unavailable until the key opens.
Description: ##MS_DatabaseMasterKey## exists.

Title: Always Encrypted keys present
Recommendation: Column master keys and column encryption keys must stay reachable from the application. Moving the database does not move the CMK store (certificate, Azure Key Vault, or Windows store).
Description: Always Encrypted column master keys or column encryption keys.

Title: Query Store has forced plans
Recommendation: Forced plans are a baseline, not a guarantee. Re-evaluate them after the compatibility-level change; a plan forced on the old cardinality estimator can become a regression on the target.
Description: sys.query_store_plan.is_forced_plan = 1. Plan XML is not copied into this report.

Title: SOAP or HTTP endpoint still defined
Recommendation: Native SOAP endpoints are discontinued. Remove the endpoint and replace it with an application service before upgrade.
Description: sys.endpoints type SOAP or HTTP.

Title: Non-TSQL endpoint present (Service Broker, mirroring, or availability group)
Recommendation: Record every endpoint. HADR, mirroring and Service Broker endpoints must exist, with matching certificates, on the target before cutover.
Description: Endpoints other than TSQL and SOAP.

Title: Server-scoped DDL trigger present
Recommendation: Server triggers do not move with a database backup. Script them explicitly and re-test them on the target instance.
Description: sys.server_triggers.

Title: Server credential present
Recommendation: Credentials do not restore with a user database. Recreate each credential on the target. This assessment does not read the secret.
Description: sys.credentials name and identity only.

Title: SQL Agent proxy present
Recommendation: Agent proxies reference credentials. Recreate the proxy and its subsystems on the target before jobs that use it will run.
Description: msdb.dbo.sysproxies. The credential secret is not read.

Title: Linked-server login mapping is not a self-mapping
Recommendation: A remote SQL login or an unmapped linked login fails after the remote security principal changes. Recreate the mapping on the target. No password is collected.
Description: sys.linked_logins where uses_self_credential = 0.
